title: Agentic Workflow Protocol manifest (v1alpha3)
description: Structural rules of AWP v1alpha3 (spec/v1alpha3/README.md). Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in schema/README.md as semantic validation rules. Per-kind entry points: #/$defs/Workflow, #/$defs/Agent, #/$defs/Policy, #/$defs/WorkflowRun.

ActionKey.description: Action identifier, group identifier or wildcard pattern with a final segment * (spec 5.5.3, 5.5.4).

Date.description: RFC 3339 full-date (spec 3.7). Calendar validity is a semantic rule.

Digest.description: Digest <algorithm>:<lowercase hex> (spec 3.8). sha256/sha384/sha512 have fixed lengths; other algorithms are accepted syntactically.

Expression.description: Expression-enabled string (spec 3.9): only inputs.<name>, steps.<id>.outputs.<name>, execution.id, execution.environment, forEach.item, forEach.item.<key> and forEach.index are allowed inside ${{ }}.

Approver.description: Exactly one of role or user (spec 7.6).

ApprovalStep.description: Payload of an approval step (spec 5.6.1, 7.6): the fields of Approval without requiredFor and separationOfDuties, which apply only at workflow level.

Secret.description: Secret declaration (spec 7.9). Secret values never appear in manifests.

ActionGroups.description: Action groups (spec 5.5.4). Nesting is a semantic rule.

AgentEntry.description: One entry of spec.agents: agent reference if it has ref, remote agent if it has protocol, otherwise inline agent (spec 5.4).

name.description: Output name (spec 5.6.1). Also the file name in $AWP_OUTPUTS (spec 5.6.4).

Environments.description: Environments (spec 7.10). Keys are organizational environment names.

Metadata.description: Object metadata (spec 4): the subset of Kubernetes ObjectMeta that authors write. Fields that an object store populates are tolerated and ignored.

Condition.description: Policy rule conditions (spec 8.3): each attribute maps to an operator object. Unknown attributes are rejected; ordering operators are limited to data.classification and risk.level.

Workflow.description: A complete manifest of kind Workflow (spec 3.2, 5).

status.description: Written by the runtime or object store (shape: ManifestStatus, spec 3.11). Ignored by validators and excluded from the digest (spec 3.2).

Agent.description: A complete manifest of kind Agent (spec 3.2, 6).

status.description: Written by the runtime or object store (shape: ManifestStatus, spec 3.11). Ignored by validators and excluded from the digest (spec 3.2).

Policy.description: A complete manifest of kind Policy (spec 3.2, 8.2).

status.description: Written by the runtime or object store (shape: ManifestStatus, spec 3.11). Ignored by validators and excluded from the digest (spec 3.2).

Extensions.description: Extension fields (spec 3.3): keys start with x-, values are opaque to AWP. Replaces the x- fields of v1alpha1, which a Kubernetes structural schema cannot express.

AnswerField.description: One field of an answer schema (spec 5.8): a primitive value, as in MCP elicitation.

AnswerSchema.description: Schema of a structured answer (spec 5.8): a flat object of primitive fields, the requested-schema subset of MCP elicitation.

InputStep.description: Payload of an input step (spec 5.8): ask a person and wait for the answer.

HumanInput.description: Lets an agent ask a person during its step (spec 5.8).

StatusCondition.description: A status condition in the shape of Kubernetes metav1.Condition (spec 3.11).

ManifestStatus.description: Status a runtime writes on a Workflow, Agent or Policy (spec 3.11). Validators ignore it (spec 3.2).

digest.description: Digest of the manifest as the runtime validated it (spec 9.1).

WorkflowRunStatus.description: Status a runtime writes on a WorkflowRun (spec 10.8). Validators ignore it (spec 3.2).

workflow.description: The manifest the execution is pinned to (spec 10.1).

outputs.description: Produced outputs. Values are not stored in status, only references.

RunMetadata.description: Metadata of a WorkflowRun (spec 10.8): as Metadata, but a client MAY set generateName instead of name.

WorkflowRunSpec.description: Request for one execution of a workflow (spec 10.8).

workflowRef.description: The workflow to run, in the namespace of the WorkflowRun. version and digest are assertions, not selectors.

WorkflowRun.description: An execution of a workflow as an object (spec 10.8).

status.description: Written by the runtime (shape: WorkflowRunStatus). Ignored by validators (spec 3.2).

ForEach.description: Iteration over a list (spec 5.6.5): the step runs once per item, bounded by maxItems and concurrency.

items.description: Exactly one reference to an array input or to an output of a step this step depends on.
